functions.name: وزارة شؤون مجلس الوزراء, Ministry of Cabinet Affairs (named Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and the Future from February 2016 to July 2020)
functions.legalForm: federal ministry

established.act: Ministry established 2006 (moca.gov.ae About MOCA). Foresight mandate: 12th Cabinet formation, oath of 16 February 2016 naming the Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Future (mofa.gov.ae); UAE Strategy for the Future, ratified by the Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and The Future, announced 29 September 2016 (uaecabinet.ae)

functions.unitNote: Condition 1: federal ministry. Condition 2: standing, no end date. Condition 3: the ministry's own official page (moca.gov.ae Area of Focus 'Future Foresight', and u.ae 'Shaping the future', updated 24 Nov 2025) says the ministry is mandated with the portfolio of the future of the UAE: forecasting opportunities, trends, challenges and future implications, providing alternatives, and the UAE Future Foresight Strategy (original term استشراف المستقبل, 'future foresight'), which launches studies and scenarios for all priority sectors. No horizon is stated. Condition 4: the strategy covers health, education, environment, economy, government, international relations and other domains. Establishment date used: 2016-09-29, the first official record found that names scenarios and foresight for this ministry; the 16 Feb 2016 record names the 'Future' portfolio but no listed term. Both dates fall in 2016. The July 2020 rename to Ministry of Cabinet Affairs is a rename of the same body, and the current official pages still state the foresight mandate, so it is not coded as a closure. Home of the PMO, the Centennial Lab, the Government Development and the Future Office and MBRCGI, which are listed separately.

I1.note: Official records date the foresight mandate to 2016: the 16 Feb 2016 oath of the 12th Cabinet names the Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Future, and the 29 Sep 2016 announcement of the UAE Strategy for the Future, ratified by the Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and The Future, gives the ministry its foresight role. I2.note: No forward-looking product dated 2023-10-02 to 2026-10-02 and issued by the Ministry of Cabinet Affairs was found at an official URL. The ministry's publications API (moca.gov.ae/Api/DownloadCenter/GetDownloads, 63 English items) lists for 2023 to 2026 innovation case-study reports of MBRCGI, guidelines, a public-policy guidebook and the 'We the UAE 2031' vision. None is a futures product, and the MBRCGI reports belong to a unit that fails the unit test. The latest futures-type item, 'Future Possibilities' (2020), predates the window. The Government Development and the Future Office's white paper '10 Future Emerging Opportunities' (November 2023, horizon the next decade) was found only in news and belongs to an office not shown to meet the unit. Low confidence because that office's status and the paper's official URL are unresolved.

I3.note: Under the codebook, the effective chief executive of the UAE is the Prime Minister. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum has been Prime Minister since 2006, before the foresight mandate of 2016 (date used: 2016-09-29), and is still Prime Minister on the u.ae cabinet page updated 24 Nov 2025 (Wayback copy of 19 Aug 2026). The change of President in May 2022 is not a change of the effective chief executive under the codebook.

I4.note: No GFF established since 1990 was found to have ended. The 2020 rename of the Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and the Future to the Ministry of Cabinet Affairs kept the same body and the foresight mandate. Low confidence because the FNC Future Committee (2019) appears in leads and is absent from the 18th-term committee list (November 2023). Its mandate and standing status could not be read because almajles.gov.ae did not render. If the adjudicator finds that it met the unit, I4 reads 1.

functions.unitNote: Cond 1: the government's staff office. Cond 2: standing. Cond 3: RVOG art. 32 cter mandates a 'langfristige und kontinuierliche Lage- und Umfeldanalyse'; the BK's official page states its aim as identifying and anticipating developments of the coming 10 to 15 years and names 'Zukunftsszenarien'. LOW CONFIDENCE: 'Lage- und Umfeldanalyse' (situation and environment analysis) is not itself a listed term; the coder reads it, with the page's 10-15 year horizon and future scenarios, as horizon scanning and long-term scenarios. The 2026 report calls the work 'strategische Vorausschau'. Cond 4: cross-departmental. The BK existed long before; the date is the foresight mandate (in force 1 Jan 2015). Earlier BK foresight work (Herausforderungen 2007, Perspektiven 2025/2030) predates the statutory mandate but no earlier dated mandate record was read.
